definitionZh: :只读 CSS 伪类选择用户无法编辑的元素(如某些输入类型和文本区域). HTML属性只读没有效果的元素(如,,,以及所有其他非形式元素)也由:read-只读伪类选择. 事实上:只读匹配任何不匹配的:read-write,使其相当于:not(:read-write).
sourceDefinition: The :read-only CSS pseudo-class selects elements (such as certain input types and textarea) that are not editable by the user. Elements on which the HTML attribute readonly doesn't have an effect (such as , , and all other non-form elements) are also selected by the :read-only pseudo-class. In fact, :read-only matches anything that :read-write doesn't match, making it equivalent to :not(:read-write).
